claims.assertion: Gosia’s manifestation model holds that outcomes reflect deep subconscious and unconscious beliefs as well as conscious intentions; conflicting patterns can impede what a person consciously wants.
claims.speaker: Gosia
claims.qualifiers: The source frames this as a metaphysical account of manifestation, not an established psychological mechanism.

review_flags: The source presents unsupported claims about manifestation and subconscious causation; these are recorded as an attributed model.
coverage_gaps: the source’s discussion of practical action and focused intention
the source’s advice about shadow work and integrating past experiences
